test_title: PYST 39: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 01 Mar, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

As a child, he was tender and warm - hearted towards ________.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence requires a word that refers to people, as **it describes the child's warm-hearted nature towards others.**
 
• The term** "everybody"** fits best in the context, indicating a general warm-heartedness towards all people.
 
• Options like "one", "everywhere", and "whomever" do not fit well in the context of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"As a child, he was tender and warm-hearted towards **everybody**."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "one"** – This does not fit the context as it refers to an individual person rather than a group.
 
• **Option 3: "everywhere"** – This refers to places, not people, thus is not suitable.
 
• **Option 4: "whomever"** – This refers to any person, but the sentence requires a more general term like "everybody."
